(pa)༄༅/ /lam 'bras lam skor sogs kyi gsan yig bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma la/ /mchog tu gus pas phyag 'tshal nas/ /sangs rgyas nas bar

tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// lam 'bras lam skor sogs kyi gsan yig bzhugs// ༄༅// sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma la// mchog tu gus pas phyag 'tshal nas// sangs rgyas nas brgyud bla ma'i mtshan// gsol ba gdab phyir bri bar bya// rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a ba dhū ti pa/ rje ga ya dha ra/ rje 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ rje se mkhar chung ba kun rig rje zhang dgon pa ba chos 'bar/ rje sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po'i bar du lam 'bras kyi brgyud pa'o// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ ḍoṃ bi he ru ka a la la badz+ra/ nags khrod pa/ gar+bha ri pa/ bsod snyoms pa/ rgyal ba dpal gyi ye shes/ mi thub zla ba/ dge slong dpa' bo rdo rje/ shes rab dbang po mdzes pa/ rje 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon sgyi chu ba/ dgra bla/ rje sa skya pa yab sras/ 'grel pa ku mu ta dang 'grel pa gzhung gi brgyud pa'o// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ rta mchog bi na pa ta/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ lak+ṣ+mī pa ta/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ gun+dha ri pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ chos kyi bzang po'i zhabs/ tog rtse pa/ bhu sha na pa/ dharmā pa/ kar+ṇa pa/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ rje 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ rje se mkhar chung ba/ rje zhang dgon pa ba/ rje sa skya pa yab sras rnams/ slob dpon tog rtse pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi brgyud pa'o// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ bi la s+ya badz+ra/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ lcam lak+ṣ+mī/ nag po spyod pa ba/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ rje ga ya dha ra/ man chad lam 'bras dang mtshungs/ mtsho skyes rdo rje dang pad+ma ba'i lam gyi brgyud pa'o// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ dpal phyag na rdo rje/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ slob dpon klu sgrub/

ār+ya de ba/ dge slong nag po zhabs/ slob dpon zla ba grags pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ ga ya dha ra/ man chad lam 'bras dang 'dra ba ni slob dpon ār+ya de wa'i mchod rten gyi drung du thob pa'i brgyud pa'o// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ de wā kā ra tsan+d+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ rje 'brog mi man chad lam 'bras dang 'dra ba ni phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i brgyud pa'o// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje phag mo/ dzā lan+dha ra pa/ nag po spyod pa ba/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ ga ya dha ra man chad lam 'bras dang 'dra ba ni/ gtum mo lam yongs su rdzogs pa dang yon po bsrang ba'i lam gnyis kyi brgyud pa'o// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ dpal bde ba chen po/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ dpal tshangs ba'i zhabs/ bram ze mo grub pa'i rdo rje/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti bar pa/ slob dpon gos bral zhabs/ rgyal po dz+nyā na bhū ti/ shrī yo bhū ti/ pad+ma badz+ra/ ḍam̐ bi he ru ka yan lag bar ma'i zhabs/ lha mo bung ba'i pad+ma/ lcam lak+ṣ+mī/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti chung ba/ rat+na badz+ra/ kha che shes rab gsang ba/ rje 'brog mi man chad lam 'bras dang 'dra ba ni/ in+d+ra bhū ti'i lam gyi brgyud pa'o// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha pa/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ ri khrod mgon po/ lū yi pa/ dā ri ka pa/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dzā lan+dha ra pa/ nag po spyod pa ba/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs/ bar ma'i slob dpon/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa sku mched gnyis/ bla ma klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ bla ma mal lo ts+tsha ba/ chos rje sa skya pa yab sras rnams 'khor lo bde mchog gi dbang bskur ba dang*/ rtsa ba'i rgyud bshad rgyud rnams kyi brgyud pa'o// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje phag mo/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ de man chad snga ma dang 'dra ba'i dril bu skor gsum yan lag dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa'o//

༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ jo bo nā ro pa/ pham thing pa/ gcen 'jigs med grags pa/ gcung dus 'khor ba/ bla ma mal lo ts+tsha ba/ chos rje sa skya pa yab sras rnams ni/ nā ro mkha' spyod yan lag dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa'o// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen/ ri khrod dbang phyug slob dpon me trī pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ ka ma la badz+ra/ dza ma se na/ lo ts+tsha ba dar ma yon tan/ bla ma rje btsun pa/ bla ma chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po rin po che rnams/ me tri mkha' spyod dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i brgyud pa'o// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal sde pa/ bi ma la gup+ta/ rat+na badz+ra/ rat+na kīrti/ bla ma pan+da ba/ bla ma gnyan lo ts+tsha ba/ bla ma gnam kha'u pa/ chos rje sa skya pa yab sras rnams ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs kyi skor rnams dang*/ gnyan gyi sgrol ma'i brgyud pa'o// ༈ //yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po'i zhabs/ dpal 'dzin/ nā ro pa/ as+thū la badz+ra/ bla ma bha ro phyag rdum/ rje mal lo ts+tsha ba/ chos rje sa skya pa yab sras rnams/ gshin rje gshed rgyud gsum yan lag dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa'o// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i klu/ klu las byung ba'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ o ḍ+yan bi shī rgyal po/ bi su kalpa/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ ār+ya de ba/ slob dpon zla ba grags pa/ slob pa'i rdo rje/ spyod pa ba/ pa de wa/ dpal sbas/ bi d+ya bha dra/ de pā ka ra/ bla ma 'gos lo ts+tsha ba/ dbus pa dge ser/ gnam kha'u pa sku mched/ chos rje sa skya pa chen po/

kha'u'i rdo rje bdud 'joms/ rje btsun chen po/ chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po rin po che rnams gsang ba 'dus pa/ 'phags pa'i skor gyi brgyud pa'o// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ slob dpon rab 'byor bskyangs/ kun dga' snying po/ shes rab bskyangs/ zhi ba snying po/ dge mtshan bshes gnyen/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrad+dhā ka ra warma/ jo bo rin chen bzang po/ brag stengs pa yon tan tshul khrims/ bla ma mal lo ts+tsha ba/ chos rje sa skya pa chen po/ gnyag ston dbang rgyal/ rje btsun chen po/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta las/ de nyid bsdus pa dang*/ dpal mchog dang po la sogs pa yi ge'i rgyud chen po yan lag dang bcas pa rnams brgyud do// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ bram ze mchog sred/ nor bu gling pa/ bde ba'i rdo rje shrad+dhā ka ra warma/ jo bo rin chen bzang po/ brag stengs pa yon tan tshul khrims/ bla ma mal lo ts+tsha ba/ rje sa skya pa yab sras rnams las chos skyong gur mgon lha mo'i skor rnams brgyud pa'o// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ bi la s+ya badz+ra/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ lcam lak+ṣ+mī/ dā ri ka pa/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ rnal 'byor ma tse/ ke ra ḍī pa/ slob dpon me trī pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ bla ma sgyi chu ba/ rje sa skya pa yab sras rnams las brgyud nas phyag rgya chen po grub pa'i skor yan lag dang bcas pa rnams brgyud do// ༈ //sangs rgyas/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sha ba ri pa/ slob dpon me trī pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ ba ri lo ts+tsha ba/ bla ma sgyi chu ba/ chos rje sa skya pa yab sras rnams las phyag rgya chen po snying po'i skor brgyud do// ༈ //sangs rgyas/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba/ rdo rje gdan pa/ rdo rje gdan pa chung ba/ bla ma ba ri lo ts+tsha ba/

chos rje sa skya pa yab sras rnams las/ 'jam dpal dang*/ mi g.yo ba dang*/ gzungs gra lnga dang*/ rdo rje gdan pa'i chos drug la sogs pa dpag tu med pa brgyud do// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ ār+ya de ba/ shākya bshes gnyen/ zla ba grags pa/ rol ba'i rdo rje/ skal ldan grags pa'i 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pa/ 'od mdzad lha/ chos kyi 'byung gnas zhi ba/ bi k+ṣa ta de ba/ chos rje paṇa chen shākya shrī/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po las/ gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje lha sum cu so gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang rgyud sgrub pa'i thabs yan lag dang bcas pa brgyud do// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje snying po/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ rdo rje slob dpon tsi lu pa/ dus 'khor ba che ba/ dus 'khor ba chung ba/ a nu sa ma rak+ṣi ta/ sā dhu pu tra/ dharmā ka ra/ dharma mi tra/ bi k+ṣa ta de wa/ paṇa chen shākya shri/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ bla mchos kyi rgyal po las/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba dang 'grel ba dri ma med pa'i 'od yan lag dang bcas pa brgyud do// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ slob dpon rab 'byor bskyangs/ kun dga' snying po/ shes rab bskyangs/ zhi ba snying po/ dge mtshan bshes gnyen/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrad+dhā ka ra warma/ jo bo rin chen bzang po/ mnang pa brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ gnyal pa shī ma shes rab/ gnur nyi ma'i 'od zer/ gnur pa badz+ra sidha/ rtsa skya pa grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bla ma klog skya dbang phyug grags pa/ bla ma ldong shes rab dpal/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po las/ de nyid bsdus pa'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba brgyud do// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon la li ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa/

pad+ma badz+ra/ dī paṃ ka ra rak+ṣi ta/ bla ma rwa rdo rje grags pa/ rwa lo ts+tsha ba chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng*/ bla ma klog skya pa dbang phyug grags pa/ bla ma ldong*/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po las/ dpal gshin rje gshed rgyud gsum/ dkyil 'khor chen po gsum gyi dbang bka' sgrub pa'i thabs yan lag dang bcas pa rnams brgyud do// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon ku ku ri pa/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ ḍoṃ bi he ru ka ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta zhi ba bzang po/ bla ma mar pa chos kyi blo gros/ rngog chos kyi rdo rje/ rngog jo sras mdo sde/ sngo tsha chos sku/ sngo tsha dkon mchog klog skya dbang phyug grags pa/ bla ma ldong ston/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po las/ ma hā mā yā'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba dang rtsa ba'i rgyud yan lag drug dang bcas pa rnams brgyud do// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ ār+ya de ba/ a su ra'i brag phug na gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ma rus pa'i phreng ba can/ bal po rnam par rgyal ba/ dpa' bo sde/ mar pa lo ts+tsha ba/ rngog chos kyi rdo rje/ rngog mdo sde/ sngo tsha chos sku/ sngo tsha dkon mchog klog skya dbang phyug grags pa/ bla ma ldong*/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po las dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba dang*/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i 'grel pa yan lag dang bcas pa rnams brgyud do// ༈ //bcom ldan 'das dpal gshin rje gshed/ slob dpon bram ze dpal 'dzin/ bir+wa pa/ ḍoṃ bi he ru ka bi ra ḍi pa/ gam+bhi ra ma ti/ niṣ+ka laṃ ka de wi re ban+d+ra pra bha ba/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po glo bo lo ts+tsha ba/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po las gshin rje gshed dmar po lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang*/ sgrub pa'i thabs yan lag dang bcas pa rnams brgyud do//

༈ //rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon lū hi pa/ slob dpon ḍeṅgi pa/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ dzā lan+dha ra pa/ a nu pa ma shrī/ shu bhaṃ ka ra gup+ta/ a nan+da/ ka ra gup+ta/ pu tsa ri ta/ paṇ+ḍi ta rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ bla ma glo bo lo ts+tsha ba/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po las/ rdo rje phreng ba'i lugs kyi bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dbang*/ rdo rje bdag med ma/ lha mo bco lnga'i dbang*/ rje btsun ma rdo rje sgrol ma lha bcu gcig gi dbang dang*/ ku ru kul+le lha mo bco lnga'i dbang*/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dbang*/ gzhan yang rdo rje phreng ba yan lag dang bcas pa mang du brgyud do// ༈ //'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon bir+wa pa/ ḍoṃ bi ba/ ba ri ḍi pa/ ma ti gar+bha/ gam+bhi ra ma ti/ niṣ+ka laṃ ke de wi/ dpyal lo ts+tsha ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rga lo/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po las/ gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang sgrub pa'i thabs yan lag dang bcas pa brgyud do// ༈ //yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ mu trā sid+dhi/ pur+ṇa sidha/ de we shwa ra/ shān+ti gar+bha smṛ ti dz+nyā na kīrti/ tsong steng ngag gi dbang phyug bla ma shes rab rdo rje/ rngog chos kyi rdo rje/ 'u yug pa ram ston rdo rje'i sgra/ mang dkar ba dkar po/ grang so rkong ston/ rlan ston gsal 'od/ phyar ston bsod nams bzang po/ jo btsun bsod nams skyabs/ bla ma go lung pa chen po/ bla ma glo bo lo ts+tsha ba/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po las 'jam dpal gsang ldan gyi dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba dang de'i cha lag rnams brgyud do// ༈ //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sha ba ri pa/

slob dpon dz+wa ba ri pa/ bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta de ba pur+ṇa ma ti/ lo ts+tsha ba chos kyi bzang po/ gshen ston rin chen dngos grub/ dmar sgang bu/ kha ba chos kyi rgyal po/ bla ma pu rangs pa/ kyi ston dkon mchog 'bar/ lha rje ston pa/ dam pa thub she yol ston pad+ma/ bla ma go lung pa chen po/ bla ma glo bo lo ts+tsha ba/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po las/ phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang*/ de'i rgyud sgrub pa'i thabs yan lag dang bcas pa rnams brgyud do// ༈ //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ 'phags pa sgrol ma/ slob dpon nyi ma sbas pa/ tsan+d+ra gar+bha/ dze tā ri/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ shrad+dhā ka ra warma/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shrī/ paṇ+ḍi ta mañju shrī/ bla ma mal lo ts+tsha ba/ pu tser lo ts+tsha ba/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la stod dbang rin/ mchims chos kyi seng ge mchims blo gros brtan pa/ slob dpon mchims nam mkha' grags/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po las/ u rgyan sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang*/ de'i yan lag tshang ba rnams brgyud do// ༈ //yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ sdud pa po byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ de'i slob ma'i mchog lnga ni/ pad dkar ye shes/ ye shes rdo rje/ rgyal po sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ nyi ma'i snying po/ rgyal rigs sa ra pa'o// de lnga ka'i slob ma kun dga' snying po/ ta thā ga ta badz+ra/ shrad+dhā ka ra warma/ lo ts+tsha ba rin chen bzang po/ co lung legs pa'i shes rab/ sum ston ye shes 'bar/ gnyan ston tshul khrims 'bar/ thod pa dben tsha grags pa/ thod pa 'od zer/ gtsang rong gi slob dpon chos kyi mgon po dpal/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po las ngan song sbyong ba kun rig gi dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba brgyud do// ༈ //bcom ldan 'das/ 'jam dpal/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra che ba/

a mo gha badz+ra chung ba/ bla ma skyo 'od 'byung*/ tsangs yang dag 'bar/ tsangs yang dag rdo rje/ rngog rdo rje rgyal po/ gze ba don grub ye shes/ slob dpon 'kham pa shākya rdo rje/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po las skyo lugs kyi rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba brgyud do// ༈ //grub pa'i slob dpon/ rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ bla ma chos rje pa/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po las sgrol ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang*/ de'i sgrub thabs brgyud do// ༈ //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje ldan ma/ grub pa'i slob dpon sa ra he ta/ bhe ni ta bha ṭa/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta saṃ gra ma shrī/ slob dpon 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ slob dpon mkhas pas phug pa/ slob dpon mngon pa dbang phyug brtson 'grus/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po las/ u rgyan sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang de'i yan lag tshang ba rnams brgyud do// ༈ //bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan 'di rnams/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po rin po che de nyid la/ bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis zhus nas/ mtshal mdor bsdebs pa'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o// ༈ //bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
